entries.name: ACUMATICA_URL
entries.description: The Acumatica instance's https address, with its path if it isn't at the site root. Not a secret.
howToGet: It is the address the business signs in to Acumatica at, up to but not including /Main.

entries.name: ACUMATICA_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The connected application's client ID: a GUID, an @ and the tenant. Not a secret on its own.
howToGet: In Acumatica, open Connected Applications (SM303010), add an application named KaratOS with the Resource Owner Password Credentials flow, and copy its client ID.

entries.name: ACUMATICA_CLIENT_SECRET
howToGet: On the same application's Secrets tab, add a shared secret and copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: ACUMATICA_USERNAME
entries.description: The Acumatica user made for KaratOS, whose role can only view stock items and sales orders. Not a secret.
howToGet: In User Roles (SM201005), make a role that has View Only on Stock Items (IN202500) and Sales Orders (SO301000) and nothing else.
In Users (SM201010), add a user named karatos with only that role.

entries.name: ACUMATICA_PASSWORD
howToGet: Set a long generated password for the karatos user and copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: ACUMATICA_ENDPOINT_VERSION
entries.description: Optional. The Default endpoint version to read: 23.200.001, 24.200.001, 25.100.001 or 25.200.001. Defaults to 24.200.001. Not a secret.
howToGet: Web Service Endpoints (SM207060) lists the Default endpoint's versions on the instance; pick the newest listed here.
